description: Defines custom formatters for channel state information and floating point options, used for formatted output of CSI data in a wireless communication context.

classes.name: formatter<std::optional<float>>
classes.description: Custom formatter for optional float values, outputs 'na' if value is not present.

classes.name: formatter<ocudu::channel_state_information>
classes.description: Custom formatter for channel state information, providing verbose and concise output options.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses formatting options for the float or CSI formatter.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Formats the given data (float or CSI) into a string representation.
